overall_summary: The channel is experiencing its strongest traction with cosmic anomalies and extreme planetary physics (e.g., planets of burning ice, coal-dark atmospheres, and molten iron rain), which consistently outperform general psychology and biology facts. Mind-bending comparisons (e.g., sharks older than trees, head aging faster than feet) also show moderate success, while standard brain/psychology facts struggle to gain momentum.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet of Burning Ice' (1,055 views), 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (963 views, 34 likes), and 'The Planet Where It Rains Molten Iron' (353 views, 17 likes) are the top-performing videos.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on extreme space facts focusing on bizarre planetary conditions, cosmic structures, and mind-bending physics.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Sharks Are Older Than Trees?' (302 views) and 'Why Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet' (262 views) outperformed standard biology/psychology topics.
winning_patterns.action: Frame historical or scientific facts around shocking temporal paradoxes or unexpected age comparisons.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (53 views), 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' (38 views), and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (17 views) failed to capture audience interest.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from generic brain/psychology facts unless they can be framed with a high-stakes mystery or a shocking physical manifestation.
